answer: The purpose of the Wild Feature Card in arXiv 2305.17910 is to provide players with creative space to come up with their own feature that can mitigate a harm challenge played against them. It can be played against any harm, but must be accompanied by a narrative on how it obviates the challenging harm. Players need to convince a majority of the other players that their imagined feature is appropriate for the harm challenge in order to succeed against it.
